name: Segway Navimow
headline: Segway Navimow ownership, wire-free mowers and Willand operating structure
description: A source-backed profile of Ninebot's controlling interest, Willand's manufacturing and trademark roles, Navimow mower platforms, regional entities and channels.
metaDescription: Segway Navimow profile: Ninebot ownership, Willand manufacturer, X4 and i2 robotic mowers, regional entities, channels and strategy.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Ninebot, Segway Navimow or Willand. Group ownership, legal-manufacturer records and regional company roles are identified separately and should not be generalized to every shipment.

ownership.summary: Segway Navimow is controlled by Ninebot Limited through its majority interest in Willand (Beijing) Technology and related Navimow entities. Ninebot reported a 69.26% group interest at 31 December 2025 after employee and core-team equity incentives, so the business is controlled but not wholly owned. Willand is the core operating company, owner of key Navimow trademarks and legal manufacturer named in current manuals. Xiaomi remains a minority investor in Ninebot and is not Navimow's parent company.

productPortfolio.name: Navimow i series and i2
productPortfolio.positioning: Compact and mid-market wire-free mowers using model-dependent RTK, vision, LiDAR or AWD configurations.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Creates a wide entry and mid-tier range, but navigation hardware, antenna requirements, lawn capacity and drive system must be checked by SKU.

productPortfolio.name: Navimow H2 series
productPortfolio.positioning: Residential mowers using AI triple-fusion positioning across LiDAR, Network RTK and vision.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Targets gardens with mixed signal conditions while adding network-coverage and sensor-support dependencies.

productPortfolio.name: Navimow X3 and X4
productPortfolio.positioning: Large-lawn premium platforms combining multi-sensor positioning, stronger terrain capability and higher-capacity mowing.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Supports flagship and large-property assortment tiers where site survey, slope, clearance and local service matter.

productPortfolio.name: Navimow Terranox
productPortfolio.positioning: Commercial AWD mower platform for sports turf, golf, public green space and facilities, supported by NavimowFleet.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Adds professional fleet procurement, commissioning, uptime, parts and field-service requirements beyond residential retail.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Current official i2 AWD and Terranox manuals name Willand (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd. as manufacturer.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Named product manuals and legal manufacturer
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match the manufacturer record to the exact model, regional declaration and rating label.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: A legal-manufacturer address identifies the responsible company but does not establish the physical assembly site or origin of every model and batch.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify the assembly factory, country of origin, exporter and batch traceability in supplier and customs documents.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Ninebot's annual report treats the Willand group as a product research, production and sales subsidiary and reported approximately RMB 1.98 billion in 2025 revenue.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not substitute a consolidated business figure for factory capacity or exact-SKU availability.

marketsChannels.evidence: Navimow's official company page reports availability in more than 30 countries, seven branch offices and more than 3,000 online and offline distribution channels.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm current product availability, dealer authorization and service capacity in the target country.

marketsChannels.evidence: Navimow B.V. is identified in Europe, Navimow Inc. appears in U.S. and privacy records, and Willand operates core product and software roles.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify the invoice seller, importer, app provider, data controller, warranty entity and repair route for the transaction.

marketsChannels.evidence: Official stores, authorized dealers and regional partners may carry different generations, connectivity plans and warranty terms.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify territory, channel, serial coverage, app region, subscription terms, parts and written warranty before purchase.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Navimow has developed from a boundary-wire-free residential challenger into a broad platform spanning compact, LiDAR, AWD, large-lawn and commercial fleet products. Ninebot's robotics and mobility background supports fast sensor integration, while Willand gives the mower business a defined operating center. Its buyer-side challenge is responsibility mapping: the consumer brand, controlling public company, manufacturer and regional entities are related but not interchangeable, and service maturity can vary by market.
